sections.Profile:
"Electric Hockey" is a hockey-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Exhibit Supply Company in 1953. Notably, it is considered the world's first head-to-head electro-mechanical pinball machine, featuring 12 flippers.

- Manufacturer: Exhibit Supply Company
- Years made: 1953
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Wood Rail, Hockey, Head-to-Head, Sports, Original Theme
